segments.an3.10:1.1: “Tīhi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato tayo male appahāya yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye.
segments.an3.10:1.3: Dussīlo ca hoti, dussīlyamalañcassa appahīnaṃ hoti;
segments.an3.10:1.4: issukī ca hoti, issāmalañcassa appahīnaṃ hoti;
segments.an3.10:1.5: maccharī ca hoti, maccheramalañcassa appahīnaṃ hoti.
segments.an3.10:1.6: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, tīhi dhammehi samannāgato ime tayo male appahāya yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye.
segments.an3.10:2.1: “Tīhi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato tayo male pahāya yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ sagge.
segments.an3.10:2.3: Sīlavā ca hoti, dussīlyamalañcassa pahīnaṃ hoti;
segments.an3.10:2.4: anissukī ca hoti, issāmalañcassa pahīnaṃ hoti;
segments.an3.10:2.5: amaccharī ca hoti, maccheramalañcassa pahīnaṃ hoti.
segments.an3.10:2.6: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, tīhi dhammehi samannāgato ime tayo male pahāya yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ sagge”ti.

lines: Tañhi nirayādīsu apāyesu anudahatīti anudahanaṭṭhenapi malaṃ.

Tena samannāgato puggalo mātāpitūnampi santike bhikkhusaṅghassāpi antare bodhicetiyaṭṭhānesupi jigucchanīyo hoti, sabbadisāsu cassa “evarūpaṃ kira tena pāpakammaṃ katan”ti avaṇṇagandho vāyatīti duggandhaṭṭhenapi malaṃ.
Tena ca samannāgato puggalo gatagataṭṭhāne upatāpañceva labhati, kāyakammādīni cassa asucīni honti apabhassarānīti kiliṭṭhakaraṇaṭṭhenapi malaṃ.
Apica taṃ devamanussasampattiyo ceva nibbānasampattiñca milāpetīti milāpanaṭṭhenapi malanti veditabbaṃ.
